official.deadline_central_display: February 16, 2027 (application closes promptly at 11:59 p.m. ET)
official.deadline_note: February 16, 2027 is both the scholarship application deadline and the date by which the application for admission must be received to be considered. All coursework and final exams must be completed by June 30, 2027, and final grades/amendments received after July 12, 2027 cannot be considered. ISLA - Winter is a separate award with its own deadline (September 14, 2027 for winter 2028); the February 16, 2027 deadline explicitly does not apply to it.
official.application_cycle: Fall 2027 prestigious entrance scholarships cycle (application opens November 2, 2026)
official.status_note: TMU's scholarships pages present the fall 2027 round as the current cycle: 'The application for fall 2027 awards is available on AwardSpring from November 2, 2026 until the extended deadline to apply, February 16, 2027,' closing promptly at 11:59 p.m. ET.
official.tuition_coverage_note: TMU states that 'ISLA - Fall 2027 has a value of $10,000 CAD for up to 53 recipients' and that 'this award is entrance-only and is non-renewable'; the pages do not state that the award covers, waives or is applied against tuition.

official.description: TMU describes ISLA - Fall as an award 'for undergraduate international students enrolling in a post-secondary institution for the first time' who are 'starting their first year of a full-time 4-year (or 5 year co-op) undergraduate degree at TMU and paying international student fees,' and 'for students who do well academically, volunteer, join clubs and show leadership qualities.' It is one of TMU's prestigious entrance scholarships and is entrance-only and non-renewable.
official.program_type: Prestigious entrance scholarship (university international merit award)
official.english_requirement: TMU sets no separate English test for ISLA itself, but admission to most TMU programs requires a senior-level English course plus, unless exempt, an English proficiency test: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, TOEFL iBT 83 (92 for some programs) before January 21, 2026 or 4.5 iBT on or after, CAEL 60 or 70, PTE 60, Duolingo English Test 120, or Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency at 180+. Applicants who completed 4 years of full-time high school study in Canada or another listed exempt country/territory, or at a school where English is the primary language of instruction, are not required to write a test.

applicant_utility.summary: ISLA - Fall is a one-time $10,000 CAD entrance award for up to 53 first-year international undergraduates starting a 4-year (or 5-year co-op) degree at TMU in September 2027, and it is the single largest international entrance award TMU publishes for that intake. The money is a fixed value rather than a tuition waiver or a living allowance, so you still have to fund roughly $38,700-$44,700 CAD of annual tuition plus housing, food and insurance yourself. Practically, everything runs through AwardSpring, so the real bottleneck is getting your TMU student number early and having a specific, verifiable track record of volunteering, club involvement and leadership ready to write about.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A first-year international undergraduate with an 86%+ final admission average, documented volunteering and club leadership, a 4-year (or 5-year co-op) degree offer, and a study permit valid by September 2027.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for admission early enough that your TMU Student Number is issued well before November 2, 2026 - you cannot enter AwardSpring without it
Activate your TMU online identity before the portal opens so account setup never becomes the reason you miss day one
Draft the personal statement around concrete roles, dates and outcomes in clubs, volunteering and leadership, since TMU's own criteria reward evidence of exactly those
Check every condition in your offer of admission (acceptance deadline, tuition deposit, academic conditions) can realistically be met, because eligibility depends on satisfying all of them
Plan your study permit timeline now so you hold a valid permit by the start of the September 2027 term, as the award terms require
If you completed an English Language Institute pathway, confirm your route into the degree program before relying on ISLA at all - pathway students are excluded
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 11:59 p.m. ET February 16, 2027 cut-off - TMU states applications will not be accepted past the deadline under any circumstances, including technical difficulties
Applying to a program that is not a 4-year (5-year if co-op) full-time undergraduate degree
Being an English Language Institute Pathway Program student, who is explicitly excluded from ISLA
Final grades or grade amendments arriving after July 12, 2027, which cannot be considered for scholarship purposes
Falling below an 86% admission average, with scholarship averages calculated to 2 decimal points and never rounded
Treating the AwardSpring general application as the whole task and never completing the ISLA-specific follow-up and personal statement
Using generative AI to write the personal statement - the terms allow AI only for idea generation and treat fabricated or non-original statements as an academic integrity breach
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Using TMU's own published 2026-2027 international student figures, expect roughly $38,693-$44,675 CAD in annual tuition, plus $8,988-$15,147+ for on-campus residence (or $15,000-$21,000+ off-campus rent for 12 months), $1,500-$6,700 in books and supplies, a $7,570 seven-day meal plan, about $1,536 in transit and $3,200-$5,600 in personal expenses, and $948 for UHIP - a published total of approximately $62,435-$88,029 CAD. The $10,000 award covers only a fraction of that, so plan funding for the balance.
document_audit: The only award-specific document is the personal statement, but it lives inside the AwardSpring follow-up - completing the general application alone does not create an ISLA application
Your scholarship average is built from your best 6 Grade 12 U/M courses at 2 decimal points with no rounding, so 85.99% does not clear the 86% threshold
Courses completed after June 30, 2027 and grade amendments after July 12, 2027 are excluded from consideration

If you need an English proficiency test, official results must be sent by the testing agency - applicant-supplied, photocopied or surface-mailed results are not accepted, and an incomplete file can stall the admission the award depends on
alerts: The working window is effectively November 2, 2026 to February 16, 2027, and the form closes promptly at 11:59 p.m. ET - start well before the final day
ISLA - Fall and ISLA - Winter are separate awards with separate applications and deadlines; the February 16, 2027 deadline explicitly does not apply to ISLA - Winter
The award cannot be deferred - if you defer admission you must reapply in a later cycle by that cycle's deadline
Recipients are capped at 53, so meeting every minimum criterion does not guarantee an award
English Language Institute Pathway Program students are barred from ISLA, and Collaborative Nursing applicants admitted to the Centennial College partner site are not eligible for TMU scholarships
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the AwardSpring general application plus the ISLA follow-up (personal statement) online at torontomu.awardspring.ca between November 2, 2026 and February 16, 2027, then watch your TMU student email and the ChooseTMU Applicant Portal for the decision.
